{{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Grass |nickname=Chespie |jnickname=ハリさん |tmnickname=Hari-san |pokemonname=Chespin |gender=Unknown |image=[[File:Mairin Chespie.png|250px]] |caption=Mairin's Chespie |location=[[Lumiose City]] |prevonum=650 |epnum=XYS01 |epname=Mega Evolution Special I |current=[[Party|With Mairin]] |java1=[[Yuka Terasaki]] |enva1=[[Suzy Myers]] }} '''Chespie''' (Japanese: '''ハリさん''' ''Hari-san'') is [[Mairin]]'s [[first partner Pokémon]] that she received from {{an|Professor Sycamore}}. It remains [[Walking Pokémon|outside its Poké Ball]]. ==History== ===[[Mega Evolution Specials]]=== [[File:Mairin and Chespie.png|thumb|left|250px|Chespie in a coma in ''[[XYS04|Mega Evolution Special IV]]'']] Chespie appeared in the [[Mega Evolution Specials]] of {{aniseries|XY}}. It first appeared in ''[[XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I]]'' where it along with [[Mairin]] watched the {{pkmn|battle}} between [[Alain]] and [[Astrid]]. After the battle, Chespie and Mairin went up to Alain when Mairin wanted to discuss to Alain about the different forms of {{TP|Alain|Charizard}} and {{p|Absol}}. Chespie and Mairin followed Alain around while he battled various [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] Pokémon. Later, when Mairin encountered a [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Flabébé, Floette, and Florges|Yellow Flower]] {{p|Flabébé}}, she had her Chespie battle her in order for Mairin to catch her. Chespie had trouble in the beginning as Flabébé was very fast. After Alain gave Mairin advice, Mairin had her Chespie use {{m|Toxic}} which weakened Flabébé enough and Mairin was able to catch her. In ''[[XYS02|Mega Evolution Special II]]'', Chespie accompanied Mairin in Hoenn. In ''[[XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III]]'', Chespie accompanied Mairin while she sneaked aboard a helicopter as [[Alain]] does not want her from coming. It protected Mairin from ice shards caused by the rampage of [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (XY series)|Groudon}} and Primal {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (XY series)|Kyogre}} who was trying to get a knocked out Alain to safety. In ''[[XYS04|Mega Evolution Special IV]]'', Chespie accompanied Mairin to [[Lysandre Labs]]. After Alain refused to allow Mairin to travel with him, she asked Chespie to give her a moment alone. This resulted in Chespie following two scientists to a room where it found a {{p|Zygarde}} Core ([[Squishy]]) and some cells being subjected to some sort of evidently painful experiment. Chespie rescued Squishy after the equipment overloaded, but the energy Zygarde had been subjected to caused Chespie to fall into a coma, devastating Mairin. ==={{aniseries|XY}}=== Chespie made its first animated series appearance alongside Mairin in ''[[XY106|A Meeting of Two Journeys!]]'', at Lysandre Labs. Alain called [[Lysandre]] for an update on the situation, only to be informed that nothing had changed at the time. It appeared again in ''[[XY116|The Synchronicity Test!]]'', where Mairin sent Alain a video of her and Chespie. Though Chespie had shown no signs of improvement, she assured Alain that the two of them were fine, and told him to do his best. Lysandre claimed that Alain could revive Chespie by collecting [[Mega Evolution]] energy. In truth, Lysandre had no intention of helping the Spiny Nut Pokémon; the energy was actually to power a machine to influence the mind of Zygarde. After Lysandre's true colors were exposed, Mairin set out to rescue Chespie from Lysandre Labs, with the help of {{an|Serena}} and {{an|Professor Sycamore}}. Chespie was eventually rescued in ''[[XY134|The Right Hero for the Right Job!]]''. However, it ended up absorbed by Lysandre's fallback plan, a [[Giant Rock]] with the appearance of Zygarde 50% Forme, in ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'', although it was eventually rescued by {{Ash}} and Alain in ''[[XY136|Forming a More Perfect Union!]]'', temporarily halting the Giant Rock. The energy was absorbed by the Giant Rock, and as a result, Chespie finally recovered. [[Squishy]] thanked it before leaving with [[Z2]]. Chespie reappeared alongside its Trainer in ''[[XY137|Battling With a Clean Slate!]]'', where it received a medal from Professor Sycamore for the heroic efforts against [[Team Flare]]. In ''[[XY138|The First Day of the Rest of Your Life!]]'', it danced with its Trainer and Alain. It appeared again in ''[[XY140|Till We Compete Again!]]'', where it was standing by Mairin's side. ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== In ''[[JN115|Curtain Up! Fight the Fights!]]'', Chespie watched Alain's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against {{an|Leon}}. In ''[[JN129|A Flood of Torrential Gains!]]'', Chespie watched Ash's match against Leon. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:PokéTV extra scene XY136.png|thumb|250px|Chespie helping Mairin]] Chespie tends to save its Trainer from trouble and helps her when she falls over. Chespie is also shown to be friendly with other Pokémon such as when it fist bumped [[Steven's Metagross]] after its battle. It shares some characteristics with [[Clemont's Chespin]], in the sense that it can act goofy and be clumsy, similar to its Trainer. However, it has not been seen as gluttonous or mischievous. Similarly to Mairin, Chespie is a curious Pokémon with a strong sense of justice. It has been shown on several occasions to care deeply for its Trainer, using {{m|Vine Whip}} to prevent her from falling down and protecting her from harm. {{-}} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|grass||Mairin Chespie {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Vine Whip|1=Pin Missile|2=Toxic}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Vine Whip|1=Pin Missile|2=Toxic}}}} {{anmov|grass|Vine Whip|XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I}} {{anmov|bug|Pin Missile|XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I}} {{anmov|poison|Toxic|XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I}} {{anmov/f|grass}} ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="float:left; background: #{{grass color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{grass color}}" |- !
